utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-06-90-A, the Prosecutor versus Ante Gotovina and Mladen Markac. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me begin by ensuring that all the equipment is functioning properly. Mr. Gotovina, can you hear me?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT GOTOVINA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can follow Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Gotovina. Mr. Markac, can you hear me?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT MARKAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I can follow, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Markac. Let me call for the appearances of the parties. The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. ELLIOTT
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Ingrid Elliott for the Prosecution. I'm joined this morning by Nema Milaninia and our case manager, Colin Nawrot. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Elliott. Counsel for Mr. Gotovina, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Gregory Kehoe, Luka Misetic, and Guenael Mettraux for General Gotovina.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Kehoe. Counsel for Mr. Markac.

utterances.speaker: MR. MIKULICIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, everybody in the courtroom. For Mr. Markac, Goran Mikulicic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Mikulicic. As you are all aware, Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the filing of a Notice of Appeal and thereafter within 120 days after the last Status Conference for each appellant in the Tribunal's custody. A Status Conference serves two primary purposes. First, it allows the appellants an opportunity to express concerns relating to their appeal or detention conditions; second, it provides an opportunity to update the appellants with respect to the status of their case. The Status Conference is also an opportunity for the Tribunal to inquire about the mental and physical condition of the detained persons. In the present case, the last Status Conference was held on 23 May 2012. Today's Status Conference was scheduled by an order issued on 4th September 2012. I would like to begin this Status Conference by inquiring into Mr. Gotovina's and Mr. Markac's health. Mr. Gotovina and Mr. Markac - if you wish - this discussion or a part of it can take place in a closed session. Mr. Markac.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT MARKAC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, you are aware that I recently had a very serious operation and I am now in recovery. My health is now adequate and everything is all right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Mr. Markac, you have consented to some medical reports being released to me and to the Appeals Bench, and I am very pleased to take note of the progress you have been making on your health. Mr. Gotovina, you always have had fewer problems of health. Is there anything you would like to tell us about?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT GOTOVINA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, thank you for asking. Everything is fine with me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. I'm very pleased to hear that. Let me say a few words about the procedure and history of this case. On 20 July 2012 the Appeals Chamber ordered supplemental briefing on the potential for convictions under alternate modes of liability. The Prosecution filed its supplemental brief on 10 August 2012, to which Mr. Gotovina and Mr. Markac both responded on 31 August 2012. These submissions will be considered in due course. On 10 August 2012 Mr. Gotovina filed a motion challenging the Appeals Chamber jurisdiction to consider alternate forms of liability. On 10 August 2012 Mr. Markac joined Mr. Gotovina's motion. This motion will be decided in due course. At this point I would like to ask the parties whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise at this time. The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. ELLIOTT
utterances.text: No. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Gotovina.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: Just briefly, Your Honour. Obviously I -- the parties know that the Chamber has been working hard on this matter and there are several matters that are -- recently been briefed and our submissions made to the Chamber. And we were asking if there is some time-frame for a final decision, given that I know many matters are still before the Chamber.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Mr. Kehoe, when we have something to say that I can share with you, you can rest assured that I will not delay in letting you know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. The counsel for Mr. Markac.

utterances.speaker: MR. MIKULICIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, on behalf of Mr. Markac's Defence, we have no issue to raise at the moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. So I think that since there are no other matters to be raised, this brings us to the end of our proceedings for today and I would like to thank the parties for their attendance; and I call the proceedings to a close. The Court will rise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: adjourned at 11.06 a.m.
